So basically I want it to that when it's an Actor's Turn and the Formation Command is used in Battle, that Actor's Turn is then skipped afterwards.
The reason is because im using STB and if the Actor who's Turn it is, is swapped out for a different Actor that happens to have a lower Agility Stat, that swapped in Actor get to Act right away as if they had the Agility of the previous Actor that just got swapped out
So is there a way to make it use up that Turn if the Formation command is used at all?
Click to expand...
This is one thing that I found. It can probably done by something like this adding a "Cannot Move" state (like Paralyze) temporarily or using a plugin for custom logic with plugins like Yanfly's YEP Party System, often by triggering a Script Call or adding a state that consumes the turn before the swap. For a standard setup, adding a state with "Cannot Move" and "Turn Skip" enabled to the actor's skill/item works, while for complex systems (like Yanfly's ATB/ST
, you'll need a plugin command or script to ensure the turn is used up before the new actor acts. Mess around with something like this and hopefully it works so good luck!
Method 1: Using a "Cannot Move" State (Standard/Basic)
Create a State:
In the Database, go to States and create a new State (e.g., "Formation Turn Used").
Set State Effects:
In the "Effects" tab, add an "Add State" effect for the actor to apply the "Formation Turn Used" state to themselves.
Configure the State:
In the State's settings, under "Restrictions," check "Cannot Move" and potentially "Turn Skip" if available/needed for your system.
Apply via Skill/Item:
Make the Formation command a Skill or Item. In its effects, use "Add State" to apply the "Formation Turn Used" state to the
User
.
Add Plugin Command (If Using Yanfly):
If using Yanfly's Engine, you might need a plugin command to
remove
the "Cannot Move" state immediately after the swap but
after
the turn is consumed, or add a specific state that does this.
